title: Meta plans to expand the use of off-platform data, such as e-commerce purchases, to personalize content feeds; it was previously used just to serve ads (Emma Roth/The Verge)
summary: Emma Roth / The Verge: Meta plans to expand the use of off-platform data, such as e-commerce purchases, to personalize content feeds; it was previously used just to serve ads — Beginning in July, you may start seeing content related to the games you've played, your online purchases, and more across your feeds.
